title: fancy-sign: the fields an envelope carries, and the page each one lands on

contract.summary: From a last-word document with signing field nodes (signatureField, initialsField, dateSignedField), the signers and the settings: the document's fields in document order, then per signer a final-page signature (final-signature-{id}) and date (final-date-{id}), then, when per_page is initials or signature, ONE every-page field per signer (every-page-{kind}-{id}). An organisation's per_page wins and a sender who contradicts it is refused. After send, every-page fields land on the authored pages 1..N and NEVER on the generated final page. See SPEC.md.

functions.fields: fields({document, signers, settings?, org_per_page?}) -> {per_page, fields: [{id, signer_id, kind, anchor, required, label}]} | {error: SignErrorCode}

contract.referenceNote: Goldens are particle-academy/fancy-sign's Signing::create and send, with fine-print's layout, written by fancy-sign-php/tests/Conformance/Export.php. Only page NUMBERS are pinned, never rects or PDF bytes: rects are floats and the bytes depend on the platform's zlib.

implementations.symbol: (fancy-sign-js, planned; placement needs the fine-print-js writer)

notes: No discrimination probe: the placement half needs a PDF layout engine, which this package does not carry. Row 0010 is the edge the plan names (one authored page: a port counting the final page as authored puts a mark on it).
